blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Philippine National Police in Calabarzon has placed its entire force on full alert as multisectoral groups prepare to hold protest activities across the region on Monday to mark the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law. The Calabarzon police said the heightened alert status was intended to ensure preparedness and a prompt response to any situation that may arise during the commemoration. Multisectoral organizations led by Bagong Alyansang Makabayan are expected to hold simultaneous protests across Calabarzon and other parts of Southern Tagalog.
